content.comment_body: Hello, I believe I'm using a 7th generation [product_name] (24RC) and need to add two analogue outputs. However, it seems the analogue expansion modules may not be compatible with this version. Is this correct? My [product_name] is E-Stand 9; is there any way to achieve this? Thanks in advance, [user_name].

Hello, Please check the order number of your [product_name]. The current versions are [product_name] [article_no] at the end of the order number. These can both be expanded with the [product_name] AM2 AQ (analogue output expansion module) on the right side of the [product_name] base module. Hope this helps.
Hello [user_name], Thanks for your reply. My unit is a [article_no], so everything works as needed. The official documentation about this compatibility is rather confusing.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants were confused about which hardware generations of [product_name] supported analogue output expansion modules. The main insight is that product documentation did not clearly explain compatibility details, resulting in user uncertainty.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to expand the [product_name] with analogue output modules and want straightforward, clear documentation explaining hardware compatibility.
